reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 9 points better, in a game of about 217 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 4 points towards the Warriors.
The mental side leans about 2 points towards the Celtics.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 71 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 192 and 240 total points.

analyst.text: Golden State came home from an 0-5 road trip. Steve Kerr says the team is 'wiped out with injuries': Stephen Curry (oblique), Jimmy Butler and Kristaps Porzingis are out, and Draymond Green has an elbow issue. Boston play the second night of a back-to-back after Sacramento, and Jayson Tatum and Derrick White were already questionable, so rest days are a real risk. The angle leans towards Boston on morale, depending on who plays.
